r192_escalation_rule: R192 may be proposed only for one preregistered sample that passes every non-resolution identity/invariance gate yet remains curvature-INCONCLUSIVE through R160; full-set R192 is prohibited.

curvature_convergence.zero_denominator: If abs(delta_R96_R128) is below a predeclared numerical floor, report ratio UNDEFINED and classify by absolute deltas; never infer PASS from sign agreement.

terminal_behavior.PASS: both stencils meet predeclared absolute-delta and contraction requirements
terminal_behavior.INCONCLUSIVE: identity gates pass but resolution evidence does not decide curvature convergence
terminal_behavior.FAIL: a material identity, invariance, or curvature criterion fails

curvature_convergence.known_exceptions: (-4,0) prior noncontraction and (-5,0) slow contraction remain criteria stressors; criteria may not be relaxed for them.

local_stencil_consistency: Compare 1/72 and 1/144 at every valid sample without changing the integration-grid estimator.

controls.existing_solver_free: reuse E3C avoided-crossing and exact-degeneracy semantic controls
controls.later_native: must preregister model and expected fail-closed behavior before execution

decision_function: For hypothetical g_candidate<0.02, GOAL_2 evidence exists only if every newly admitted preregistered sample passes every identity, invariance, and convergence gate. One material failure fails closed.
